```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE,
                      message=FALSE, fig.align="center")
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(patchwork)

e_path <- "../raw_data/pw_result_test/ecoli_ori/"
k_path <- "../raw_data/pw_result_test/kleb_ori/"

# Load interp files
e_qc <- read.csv(paste0(e_path, "ecoli_interp_qc_assembly.csv"))
e_typing <- read.csv(paste0(e_path, "ecoli_interp_typing.csv"))
e_amr <- read.csv(paste0(e_path, "ecoli_interp_amr.csv"))
e_vir <- read.csv(paste0(e_path, "ecoli_interp_virulence.csv"))
e_plasmid <- read.csv(paste0(e_path, "ecoli_interp_plasmids.csv"))

k_qc <- read.csv(paste0(k_path, "kleb_interp_qc_assembly.csv"))
k_typing <- read.csv(paste0(k_path, "kleb_interp_typing.csv"))
k_amr <- read.csv(paste0(k_path, "kleb_interp_amr.csv"))
k_plasmid <- read.csv(paste0(k_path, "kleb_interp_plasmids.csv"))

# Combined QC (overall)
combined_qc <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  e_qc %>% mutate(species = "E. coli"),
  k_qc %>% mutate(species = "K. pneumoniae")
)
```

# 1. Overview

```{r overview-table}
combined_qc %>%
  count(species, qc) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Table 1. Isolate count by species and QC status") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE)
```

# 2. Assembly Quality (Overall)

```{r assembly-plot}
combined_qc %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = species, y = n50, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 2) +
  labs(title = "N50 by species", x = NULL, y = "N50 (bp)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# 3. Species Confirmation (Overall)

```{r species-confirm}
combined_qc %>%
  select(genome_name, species, species_name, mash_distance) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Table 2. Species confirmation via Mash distance") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover"))
```

# 4. Sequence Typing (Overall, labelled by species)

```{r mlst-table}
bind_rows(
  e_typing %>% select(genome_id, st_achtman, st_pasteur, phylogroup,
                       serotype) %>%
               mutate(species = "E. coli"),
  k_typing %>% select(genome_id, st, K_locus, K_confidence,
                       O_locus, clonal_group) %>%
               mutate(species = "K. pneumoniae")
) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Table 3. MLST and lineage typing by species") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"))
```

# 5. AMR Profiles (Overall)

```{r amr-heatmap}
# Combine AMR matrices — keep common columns only
common_amr <- intersect(colnames(e_amr), colnames(k_amr))

amr_combined <- bind_rows(
  e_amr %>% select(genome_id, any_of(common_amr)) %>%
            mutate(species = "E. coli"),
  k_amr %>% select(genome_id, any_of(common_amr)) %>%
            mutate(species = "K. pneumoniae")
)

# Heatmap
mat <- amr_combined %>%
  select(-genome_id, -species) %>%
  as.matrix()
rownames(mat) <- amr_combined$genome_id

Heatmap(mat,
        name             = "Resistance",
        col              = c("0" = "grey95", "1" = "#b2182b"),
        column_names_rot = 45,
        border           = TRUE,
        rect_gp          = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.5))
```

## 6.2 Virulence Genes

```{r ecoli-virulence}
vir_mat <- e_vir %>%
  select(-genome_id, -genome_name) %>%
  as.matrix()
rownames(vir_mat) <- e_vir$genome_id

Heatmap(vir_mat,
        name             = "Virulence",
        col              = c("0" = "grey95", "1" = "#2166ac"),
        column_names_rot = 45,
        border           = TRUE,
        rect_gp          = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.5))
```

# 7. Klebsiella — Species-Specific Analyses

## 7.1 K/O Locus & Lineage

```{r kleb-typing}
k_typing %>%
  select(genome_id, st, K_locus, K_confidence, K_identity,
         O_locus, O_confidence, lin_code, clonal_group,
         virulence_score, resistance_score) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Table 5. Klebsiella typing results") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"))
```

## 7.2 Virulence Scores

```{r kleb-virulence}
k_typing %>%
  select(genome_id, virulence_score, resistance_score,
         yersiniabactin, colibactin, aerobactin,
         salmochelin, rmp_adc, rmp_a2) %>%
  mutate(convergent = if_else(virulence_score >= 3 &
                               resistance_score >= 2, "Yes", "No")) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Table 6. Klebsiella virulence and convergence flags") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"))
```

# 8. Plasmid Replicons (Overall)

```{r plasmid-heatmap}
plasmid_combined <- bind_rows(
  e_plasmid %>% mutate(species = "E. coli"),
  k_plasmid %>% mutate(species = "K. pneumoniae")
) %>%
  mutate(across(-c(genome_id, genome_name, species),
                ~ replace_na(., 0L)))

plas_mat <- plasmid_combined %>%
  select(-genome_id, -genome_name, -species) %>%
  as.matrix()
rownames(plas_mat) <- plasmid_combined$genome_id

row_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  Species = plasmid_combined$species,
  col = list(Species = c("E. coli"       = "#2166ac",
                          "K. pneumoniae" = "#b2182b"))
)

Heatmap(plas_mat,
        name             = "Replicon",
        col              = c("0" = "grey95", "1" = "#4d9221"),
        right_annotation = row_ha,
        column_names_rot = 45,
        border           = TRUE,
        rect_gp          = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.5))
```
